outputs: Original project dialogue synthesized using generic model voice presets; no actor/celebrity impersonation requested. Only offline WAVs ship. No model, inference DLL or paid API is required in gameplay.
limitations: Stock neural voices, not human performances or full emotional direction. Mouth animation remains amplitude-driven, not visemes. Five Broken Trust lines are preparatory audio, not a playable second mission.
reproduction: Use isolated tools/voice-tools environment and art/voice-tool-requirements.txt. art/build_neural_dialogue.py preserves existing WAVs by default; --regenerate explicitly replaces output. Do not regenerate needlessly.
